code: # Example data X <- matrix(rnorm(300), ncol = 3) y_reg <- X[,1] * 2 + rnorm(100)  # Fit models with different learning rates m_lr_01 <- gradboostr_fit(X, y_reg, method = "gbm",                           learning_rate = 0.1, n_trees = 50)  m_lr_005 <- gradboostr_fit(X, y_reg, method = "gbm",                            learning_rate = 0.05, n_trees = 50)  m_lr_001 <- gradboostr_fit(X, y_reg, method = "gbm",                            learning_rate = 0.01, n_trees = 50)  # Predictions pred_01  <- gradboostr_predict(m_lr_01,  X) pred_005 <- gradboostr_predict(m_lr_005, X) pred_001 <- gradboostr_predict(m_lr_001, X)  # RMSE helper rmse <- function(a, b) sqrt(mean((a - b)^2))  # Results table df_lr <- data.frame(   learning_rate = c(0.1, 0.05, 0.01),   RMSE = c(     rmse(pred_01,  y_reg),     rmse(pred_005, y_reg),     rmse(pred_001, y_reg)   ) )  df_lr learning_rate      RMSE 1          0.10 0.9181006 2          0.05 1.1167179 3          0.01 1.7211093 df_lr %>% ggplot() +   aes(learning_rate, RMSE) +   geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkcyan") +   geom_line(color = "violet") +   theme_minimal() +   labs(     title = "Effect of Learning Rate on GBM Performance",     x = "Learning Rate",     y = "RMSE"   )

code: # Example dataset set.seed(1) X <- matrix(rnorm(300), ncol = 3) y_reg <- X[,1] * 2 + rnorm(100)  # Scale inputs (NNs perform better with scaled features) X_scaled <- scale(X)  # Fit NN models with different learning rates m_lr_01  <- gradboostr_fit(X_scaled, y_reg, method = "nn",                            hidden = 10, epochs = 80, learning_rate = 0.1)  m_lr_005 <- gradboostr_fit(X_scaled, y_reg, method = "nn",                            hidden = 10, epochs = 80, learning_rate = 0.05)  m_lr_001 <- gradboostr_fit(X_scaled, y_reg, method = "nn",                            hidden = 10, epochs = 80, learning_rate = 0.01) # Predictions pred_01  <- gradboostr_predict(m_lr_01,  X_scaled) pred_005 <- gradboostr_predict(m_lr_005, X_scaled) pred_001 <- gradboostr_predict(m_lr_001, X_scaled)  # RMSE helper rmse <- function(a, b) sqrt(mean((a - b)^2))  # Results table df_lr <- data.frame(   learning_rate = c(0.1, 0.05, 0.01),   RMSE = c(     rmse(pred_01,  y_reg),     rmse(pred_005, y_reg),     rmse(pred_001, y_reg)   ) )  df_lr learning_rate      RMSE 1          0.10 0.9087489 2          0.05 0.9464590 3          0.01 1.9934758 df_lr %>% ggplot() +   aes(learning_rate, RMSE) +   geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkorange") +   geom_line(color = "steelblue") +   theme_minimal() +   labs(     title = "Effect of Learning Rate on Neural Network Performance",     x = "Learning Rate",     y = "RMSE"   )

code: stump <- fit_stump(X, y) stump $feature [1] 1  $threshold [1] -0.05914257  $left_value [1] -2.986343  $right_value [1] 2.693698 stump_predict <- function(X, stump) {   f  <- stump$feature + 1     thr <- stump$threshold   lv  <- stump$left_val   rv  <- stump$right_val      ifelse(X[, f] <= thr, lv, rv) } stump <- fit_stump(X, y) pred_stump <- stump_predict(X, stump)  head(pred_stump, 20) [1] -2.986343  2.693698 -2.986343 -2.986343  2.693698 -2.986343 -2.986343  [8]  2.693698  2.693698  2.693698 -2.986343 -2.986343  2.693698 -2.986343 [15] -2.986343  2.693698 -2.986343  2.693698 -2.986343  2.693698
